title: 10 Best PS2 Games Tested On Snapdragon 870 | Aether SX2 Android Emulator
summary: Super Emulation gives ten PS2 games one-minute checks on an iQOO Snapdragon 870 phone, creating a compact early-AetherSX2 mobile catalogue across action, racing, horror and demanding first-party workloads.

blocks.text: The January 2022 test names the host chip and divides ten minutes cleanly among Shadow of the Colossus, Darkwatch, Mafia, Devil May Cry 3, Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks, God of War II, Need for Speed Underground 2, Splinter Cell: Double Agent, The Suffering and The Thing. Several are explicitly labelled playable by the creator. Equal one-minute slots make navigation predictable and expose workload variety without silently swapping phones between games.

A one-minute sample cannot establish completion, later-stage performance, correct effects or sustained temperature. The metadata omits exact iQOO model, AetherSX2 build, Android version, renderer, internal resolution, controller, recording overhead and the criteria behind “playable.” Results belong to an early emulator generation and should not be compared directly with modern builds. Use the chapters to identify candidate stress scenes, then reproduce them with a documented device state and frame-time capture. The video is a dated catalogue sampler, not a Snapdragon 870 compatibility percentage.
